131948.label: The origin wound
131948.note: A childhood loss that turns someone into a costumed hero: parents' funeral, fear of bats, a costume to frighten the killers.

168352.label: The secret identity
168352.note: A masked vigilante, unmasking, a double life. Also fires for Zorro, the Scarlet Pimpernel and Monte Cristo.

128514.label: Heir to a dead father's fortune
128514.note: Inherited wealth and a late father's company. Peaks on Tony Stark inheriting Stark Industries.

50224.label: The billionaire vigilante
50224.note: A reclusive rich man who fights crime outside the law.

145011.label: The Batcave and bat gear
145011.note: Hidden headquarters, the Bat-Signal, bat-themed vehicles and devices.

105434.label: Bats
105434.note: Literal bats: a swarm in a cave, performers dressed as bats, the costumed killer in the 1926 film The Bat.

84130.label: Gotham City
84130.note: The city itself as a setting: its mayor, its mob bosses, its murders.

589605.label: Commissioner Gordon
589605.note: Jim Gordon, the honest cop and ally.

584876.label: Losing the protégé
584876.note: Robin in danger, tortured or killed, and Batman's grief over it.

31044.label: The joke
31044.note: Telling jokes, morbid jokes, the world as a black joke. Fires on the Killing Joke and Joker (2019) most.

128822.label: The rogues' gallery
128822.note: A roll-call of costumed villains encountered one after another.

130069.label: Superhero powers (peaks on Superman)
130069.note: Superpowered heroes and kryptonite. Strongest on Superman's origin.

65066.label: Franchise roll-call (Wikipedia style)
65066.note: Sentences listing a franchise's cast and characters. A trace of how the summaries are written, not of the stories.

520801.label: The butler who raised him
520801.note: Alfred Pennyworth as the family butler and surrogate parent.

878889.label: Taking in an orphan as a ward
878889.note: A wealthy guardian adopts an orphan (Dick Grayson, the Gaslight orphans) who becomes a partner.

498697.label: The villain's lair
498697.note: Raiding or escaping a criminal's hideout or laboratory.

481199.label: A bomb
481199.note: Time bombs, car bombs, threats to detonate.

17909.label: A funeral
17909.note: Funerals and staged deaths: Bruce fleeing his parents' funeral, Batman's own faked funeral.

448712.label: Fell into a vat of chemicals
448712.note: The Joker's chemical-plant origin: bleached skin, a fall into a vat.

765185.label: Two-Face's coin
765185.note: Deciding fate with the flip of a scarred coin.

68088.label: Harvey Dent
68088.note: The district attorney before and after he becomes Two-Face.

13339.label: Selina Kyle
13339.note: The cat burglar and Bruce's romantic foil.

465474.label: The Riddler
465474.note: Edward Nygma and his riddles and puzzles.

496024.label: Jason Todd
496024.note: The second Robin, his death at the Joker's hands and his return.

501280.label: Ra's al Ghul
501280.note: The immortal leader of the League of Assassins and his mission to destroy Gotham.

513921.label: Lucius Fox
513921.note: The Wayne Enterprises engineer. Also fires on Zorro's nickname "The Fox" and on the Zorro movie young Bruce sees before his parents die.

876522.label: A corrupt police force
876522.note: Dirty cops and an honest officer purging corruption.

57687.label: Prison and the inmates released
57687.note: Blackgate Penitentiary, prison breaks, freeing the inmates.

465435.label: The antidote
465435.note: A poison or toxin and the race to make an antidote.

47532.label: A mutating super-formula
47532.note: The Titan steroid and other formulas that mutate their users. Mostly the Arkham games.

66576.label: Fear toxin
66576.note: Hallucinogens that weaponize fear: the blue flower compound, Scarecrow's gas.
